Index.title: Welcome to Lumen
Index.heroSubtitle: The comprehensive learning platform integrating mock tests, advanced dictation, and personalized vocabulary tracking.
Index.featuresSubtitle: Every tool you need to elevate your English proficiency is built-in and ready.
Index.featureToeicDesc: Experience real test interface with diverse exams, automatic grading, and detailed explanations.
Index.featureDictationDesc: Improve your listening skills with daily dictation exercises from various topics.
Index.featureVocabDesc: Learn vocabulary efficiently with an intelligent spaced repetition system based on the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve.
Index.featureQuizDesc: Reinforce what you learn with adaptive quizzes that target your weak spots.
Index.featureGrammarDesc: Master English grammar through bite-sized lessons and instant corrections.
Index.featureReadingDesc: Read authentic articles and translate any word or phrase with one click.
Index.featureListeningDesc: Train your ear and pronunciation with real-world conversations.
Index.featureProgressDesc: Track streaks, scores, and mastery with clear visual insights.
Index.howItWorksTitle: Your path to fluency in four steps
Index.howItWorksSubtitle: A simple, guided routine that fits into any schedule.
Index.step1Desc: Sign up in seconds and set your daily learning goal.
Index.step2Desc: Choose mock tests, vocabulary, dictation, or any track that fits your goal.
Index.step3Desc: Complete short, engaging exercises tailored to your level.
Index.step4Desc: Watch your scores and streaks grow with detailed analytics.
Index.readingSubtitle: Practice your reading comprehension with curated articles.
Index.readingError: We couldn't load the reading materials right now. Please try again later.
Index.readingEmpty: No reading materials have been published yet.
Index.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
Index.faq1A: Yes. You can create an account and access core features for free. Premium plans unlock advanced analytics and unlimited tests.
Index.faq2Q: Do I need to take a placement test?
Index.faq2A: No placement test is required. You can start any track immediately, or let the system adapt to your activity over time.
Index.faq3Q: Can I use Lumen on my phone?
Index.faq3A: Absolutely. The web app is fully responsive and works great on phones and tablets, so you can study anywhere.
Index.faq4A: Your progress is tied to your account and synced automatically, so you can pick up right where you left off on any device.
Index.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of learners building real, lasting fluency with Lumen.
Index.testimonialsSubtitle: Join thousands who have transformed their English skills with Lumen.
Index.testimonial1Quote: Lumen has completely changed how I study English. The daily practice is addictive and effective!
Index.testimonial2Quote: The preparation was seamless. My English proficiency improved significantly in just 3 months.
Index.testimonial3Quote: I love the personalized learning path. Every exercise feels tailored to my level.
Index.joinSuccessStories: Ready to start your success story?
Index.joinSuccessSubtitle: Join our community of confident English learners today.
Index.footerTagline: The all-in-one platform to learn English and build lasting fluency.

ActivityInfo.title: How Study Activities Are Calculated
ActivityInfo.subtitle: Learn how the system tracks your study engagement and heatmap intensity.
ActivityInfo.whatIsActivityDesc: An Activity represents a unit of active learning engagement you complete in the app:
ActivityInfo.flashcardReviewDesc: Each time you flip and grade a flashcard (Again, Hard, Good, Easy) = 1 activity.
ActivityInfo.vocabLearnDesc: Each new vocabulary word added to your learning cycle or practiced = 1 activity.
ActivityInfo.studySessionDesc: Active study time and progress are automatically synchronized to aggregate daily consistency.
ActivityInfo.heatmapLevelsDesc: The color intensity of each day indicates the number of activities completed:
ActivityInfo.metricsSubtitle: Your learning consistency at a glance
ActivityInfo.metricActiveDaysDesc: Total days in the selected year with at least 1 study activity.
ActivityInfo.metricStreakDesc: Consecutive days with study activity. Completing at least 1 activity daily preserves your streak.
ActivityInfo.metricLongestStreakDesc: Your highest unbroken streak of consecutive study days in the year.
ActivityInfo.metricAvgPerDayDesc: Average number of activities per active study day.

Mastery.stage2Title: Worried about forgetting after learning? Don't worry!
Mastery.stage2Desc: Lumen uses Spaced Repetition algorithms to automatically remind you of words when they need practice.
